description: redirectToAppPath helper returns a redirect response with a relative Location (path, query, optional fragment), default status 307, optional extra headers, and no dependency on request origin, forwarded headers or environment.
The helper rejects any destination that is not a single-slash-rooted app path (scheme, protocol-relative //host, backslash variants) so it cannot produce an off-site redirect.
The helper can merge incoming request query parameters into the destination without overriding parameters the destination already has.
The /msp/go/[target] route redirects through the helper; unknown targets still 404, query pass-through and Cache-Control: no-store are unchanged.

Other same-app redirects built from a request-derived origin (ApiMetadataController OpenAPI redirect, mobile handoff sign-in redirect, Teams auth callback, plus any found by the sweep) use the helper; sites that need an absolute URL stay on the public base URL helper and are recorded in SCRATCHPAD.md.
authorizationMiddleware redirects are checked against the origin the middleware resolves and corrected only if wrong behind the hosted proxy.
A source-level contract test fails when a route handler or controller passes a request-derived origin to a redirect, with a per-file allow-list that carries a reason.
